title: Michael Herrera's 2009 Indonesia encounter with an octagonal craft and a paramilitary unit
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Michael Herrera's 2009 Indonesia encounter with an octagonal craft and a paramilitary unit, about 2009 at Indonesia (disaster zone), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And so, basically, this guy is saying in 2009, he's deployed with his Marine unit to the Philippines.
Yeah. They were actually two of the guys um were actually talking about either, hey, should we smoke these guys right now?
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Herrera; adds that two of the paramilitary men talked about killing the Marines.
tellings.link_reason: Herrera tells the same 2009 Indonesia encounter that telling 1 introduces, this time firsthand, and focuses on the paramilitary unit's threat.

as_told.title: Herrera's clip: the paramilitary unit talked about killing the Marines

tellings.quote: part of Operation Katana and he was supposed to go to the Philippines. His unit was diverted. This Marine Corps unit was diverted put put in Indonesia.
tellings.difference: Adds that the deployment was part of Operation Katana and credits Jake Barber.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Michael Herrera's 2009 Marine deployment, which was diverted from the Philippines to Indonesia, where he had his encounter.

tellings.quote: answered independently. There's Michael Herrera who observed the while deployed on the USS Denver in Sumatra, Indonesia, experienced a a team in all black of of operators in a large seemingly reverse engineered man-made craft.

tellings.link_reason: Both tell Michael Herrera's encounter in Indonesia with a craft and a team of operators in black.
